**In one line**: Two more newsrooms have reportedly joined an existing copyright lawsuit targeting OpenAI and Microsoft.

### Key points
- Two additional newsrooms have signed on, expanding the group of plaintiffs.
- The dispute reportedly centers on whether news articles were used to train AI models without permission.
- OpenAI and Microsoft remain named together as co-defendants.

### Why it matters
Legal pressure over using journalism to train AI keeps building. As the plaintiff roster grows, AI companies face mounting incentive to strike licensing deals or rethink how they source training data.
